sources.citation: Kastenholz, Raimund. 2020. Coverbs and auxiliaries in Pèdè. Language in Africa 1(3): 353-372. doi:10.37892/2686-8946-2020-1-3-353-372
sources.note: Nothing on stress or accent. Confirms a three-level tone language: completive suffix has low/mid/high tonal allomorphs by transitivity (p. 356); low-tone transitive vs high-tone intransitive verb pairs (fn. 16, p. 364); 'All verb stems, including coverbs, and auxiliaries, receive a high tone marking as part of a verbal noun' (fn. 22, p. 367). States p. 354: 'Pèdè is a notoriously understudied language. With the exception of Kastenholz (2011; 2018), only pedagogical materials (e.g. Raen 1981, among others) are accessible.' Data = Almé variety.
